steps: Sign in to Vercel and open Account > Tokens
Use the Scope dropdown to pick a single team (or project) rather than everything
Choose an expiration and click Create
Copy the token - it is shown exactly once

limited.meaning: the token is valid but is limited to a project or team, so it may not read your user profile; that is fine

body_rules.meaning: Vercel says the token is not valid
Vercel says the token is not valid

least_privilege.summary: Scope the token to one team or project and set an expiration.

unverified: how Vercel answers an invalid token (believed to be a 403 that says invalidToken: true; the docs do not say)

steps: Find the leaked token in Account > Tokens
